services.desc: The cost of admission is $10 for adults and children 1 year and older. Credit Card charges will display as WOODLANDSCHILDRENMUSEU The museum’s exhibits and activities best suit young children aged seven and under but older siblings are welcome to play and explore alongside their younger siblings. Day passes are not valid for special events that require a special event ticket or advanced purchase, including, but not limited to SpookTacular, Santa event, Super Hero with Cars Day or High Noon Countdown. services.desc: Booking A $50 non-refundable deposit and a $10 non-refundable fee will be added to your registration when booking to secure the party date. Please be advised that without a deposit, parties cannot be held or reserved. All requests to reschedule or amend a party must be done 14 days prior to the scheduled party date. Rescheduling within 14 days of your party will result in loss of $50 deposit and $10 fee. A new deposit will be collected to consider a new date. This signed contract must be returned within 7 days of booking your party. Party balance will be auto charged the night before the party.
